'''Ody Mandrell's Podracer''' was a [[Color|red]] and blue [[podracer]] owned by the [[Er'Kit]] [[Gender|male]] [[Ody Mandrell]]. During the [[Boonta Eve Classic]], one of Mandrell's [[DUM-series pit droid]]s, [[DUM-4]] was sucked into one of Mandrell's [[engine]] turbines. While the pit droid was mostly intact, the turbine was ripped apart from the inside and shot. Rendering the podracer inoperative.
